description: mod-mosaic deployment configuration template. mod-mosaic receives MOSAIC purchase requests and creates purchase orders through mod-orders and mod-organizations. Resource and JVM figures are a starting point to be confirmed by PTF, not a performance measurement.

resources.name: cpu
resources.description: CPU request/limit for the mod-mosaic container

resources.name: memory
resources.description: Memory hard limit for the mod-mosaic container, in MB

resources.name: memoryReservation
resources.description: Memory reservation (soft limit) for the mod-mosaic container, in MB

java.name: MetaspaceSize
java.description: Initial Java metaspace size (threshold for the first metaspace GC, not a limit)

deployment.description: mod-mosaic is stateless (all state lives in PostgreSQL) and supports multiple replicas for HA. Two replicas cover rolling deploys; the module's request volume is low.

kong.description: Default Kong proxy timeouts are sufficient for mod-mosaic order-creation endpoints, which synchronously call mod-orders and mod-organizations. Use this only if different from default Kong configuration.

EnvVars.name: DB_HOST
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL database host. Required at startup: Liquibase migrations and Hibernate schema validation run against it

EnvVars.name: DB_PORT
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL database port

EnvVars.name: DB_USERNAME
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL database username (sourced from secret store). Needs rights to create tenant schemas

EnvVars.name: DB_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL database password (sourced from secret store)

EnvVars.name: DB_DATABASE
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL database name; tenant data is kept in per-tenant schemas inside it

EnvVars.name: DB_MAXSHAREDPOOLSIZE
EnvVars.description: Maximum HikariCP connection pool size shared by all tenants (HikariCP default is 10 when unset). Keep replicas x this value within the PostgreSQL max_connections budget

EnvVars.name: DB_MINSHAREDPOOLSIZE
EnvVars.description: Minimum number of idle connections HikariCP keeps in the pool

EnvVars.name: DB_CONNECTIONRELEASEDELAY
EnvVars.description: Time in milliseconds an idle connection stays in the pool before it is closed

EnvVars.name: DB_MAX_LIFETIME
EnvVars.description: Maximum lifetime of a pooled connection in milliseconds; keep it below any database- or proxy-side connection timeout

EnvVars.name: DB_QUERYTIMEOUT
EnvVars.description: Statement timeout in milliseconds applied to every connection; when unset, queries do not time out

EnvVars.name: DB_CHARSET
EnvVars.description: JDBC character encoding for database connections

EnvVars.name: OKAPI_URL
EnvVars.description: Base URL for outbound calls to mod-orders and mod-organizations; on Eureka this is the module's own sidecar. If it is wrong, every order-creation request fails

EnvVars.name: SERVER_PORT
EnvVars.description: HTTP port the module listens on (overrides server.port from application.yml). Must match the port in the sidecar's MODULE_URL

EnvVars.name: FOLIO_LOGGING_REQUEST_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: Enables logging of incoming requests (folio-spring-base). Intended for troubleshooting only; adds a log record per request

EnvVars.name: FOLIO_LOGGING_REQUEST_LEVEL
EnvVars.description: Detail level for incoming request logging (NONE, BASIC, HEADERS, FULL). Applies when FOLIO_LOGGING_REQUEST_ENABLED is true

EnvVars.name: FOLIO_LOGGING_EXCHANGE_ENABLED
EnvVars.description: Enables logging of outgoing HTTP exchanges to mod-orders and mod-organizations (folio-spring-base). Intended for troubleshooting only

EnvVars.name: FOLIO_LOGGING_EXCHANGE_LEVEL
EnvVars.description: Detail level for outgoing exchange logging (NONE, BASIC, HEADERS, FULL). Applies when FOLIO_LOGGING_EXCHANGE_ENABLED is true

EnvVars.name: ENV
EnvVars.description: Deployment environment identifier (folio.environment); a-z (any case), 0-9, '-' and '_' only. Module default is 'folio'

EnvVars.name: LOG4J_CONFIGURATION_FILE
EnvVars.description: Location (path or URL) of an external log4j2 configuration; the bundled log4j2.properties is used when unset

EnvVars.name: JAVA_OPTIONS
EnvVars.description: Additional JVM options for the mod-mosaic process (heap sizing, GC, agent flags, etc.)

resources.name: cpu
resources.description: CPU request/limit for the sidecar container

resources.name: memory
resources.description: Memory hard limit for the sidecar container, in MB

resources.name: memoryReservation
resources.description: Memory reservation for the sidecar container, in MB

EnvVars.name: ENV
EnvVars.description: Deployment environment identifier; must match the module's ENV

EnvVars.name: JAVA_OPTS
EnvVars.description: Additional JVM options for the sidecar process

EnvVars.name: MODULE_NAME
EnvVars.description: Name of the backend module the sidecar fronts

EnvVars.name: MODULE_URL
EnvVars.description: Internal URL (host:port) at which the mod-mosaic backend container is reachable from its sidecar; mod-mosaic listens on port 8081

EnvVars.name: MODULE_VERSION
EnvVars.description: Version of the mod-mosaic module deployed alongside this sidecar
